body.message:
Thank you for your message, and we are truly sorry to hear about your experience.

We sincerely apologise for the inconvenience caused. We understand your concern regarding the broken glasses, and we regret that your stay did not meet your expectations. Please be assured that we take your feedback seriously and will review this with the relevant team to ensure improvements are made.

We appreciate your understanding and hope to have the opportunity to host you better in the future.
